heading: US Pharma Policy and Sun Pharma's Position

html_bullets.point: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries is one of the few Indian companies selling post-patented generic drugs in the US, making it less vulnerable to potential US policy directives aimed at price cuts for innovative and branded products.

Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Limited will release its fourth quarter results for the period ending March 31, 2025, on May 22, 2025. An earnings conference call is scheduled for 06:30 PM IST on the same day, where senior management will discuss the company's performance.

Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Limited launched its corporate brand campaign in India on May 08, 2025, themed ‘touching 1,000 lives every minute’. The campaign aims to highlight the company's impact on healthcare and will be promoted across multiple platforms in nine languages.

Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Limited announced the superannuation of Mr. C. S. Muralidharan as Chief Financial Officer effective 01 July 2025. Ms. Jayashree Satagopan has been appointed as his successor, effective the same date, following a thorough selection process.
